01.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl. Government Advocate for the State.
3.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Petitioner in this writ petition seek for a direction to opposite party Nos. 1 and 2 i.e. Principal Secretary to Government Water Resources Department, Bhubaneswar and Director (R&R)-cum-Additional Secretary, Department of Water Resources, Bhubaneswar to sanction and release the awarded amount in favour of the petitioner for acquisition of land for construction of Upper Indravati Irrigation Project as per the judgment dated 07.04.2018 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Sr. Divn), Bhawanipatna in L.A.R No.55 of 2017, within a stipulated time.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner has filed an application under Section 18 of the L.A. Act for higher compensation, which was referred to Civil Court for adjudication.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The Civil Court registered it as L.A.R. No.55 of 2017 and same was disposed of on 07.04.2018 and higher compensation was awarded.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: However no action has been taken as yet for sanction and disbursement of the compensation amount.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: He further submitted that a similar writ petition bearing W.P.(C) No. 27531 of 2020 has been disposed of on 20.10.2020 directing opposite party No.1 to sanction the amount at an early stage and to take expeditious step for disbursement of the compensation amount.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: He also submitted that the present writ petition may be disposed of in terms of the order passed in that writ petition.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned Addl. Government Advocate has also no objection to the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others ..... Opposite ... on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. In view of the above, we dispose of the writ petition with a direction to opposite party No.1 to sanction the amount at an early stage and thereafter the opposite party No.3- The Special Land Acquisition Officer, Upper Indravati Irrigation Project, Kalahandi shall take expeditious step for Darpaka Bag vs State Of Odisha & Others .....
